name: Somei Kiyoha
source:
The game's protagonist. She has been raised with care as the daughter who will take over her family's clothier business. She has received education in those matters, but where men are concerned, she is inexperienced. She relies on her bodyguard Musashi like an older brother.

Following the traditions of the island, she will choose a partner to be her false husband in the renowned pleasure house Ohgiya.

(Edited from the [url=https://d3p.co.jp/ohgiya/en/]official English website[/url])
